videos.title: Why was Roman Armor SO WEAK?
videos.description:
Rome's 500 years of using weak armor, and the long experiments that made it an imperial superpower. 

From Rome's start as a Monarchy / Villanovan pre-history, to Rome's encounters with Greece, Carthage & the Gauls - failing, improving, and stealing their way across different forms of armour, cloth, bronze and iron. 

Including Rome's strange pectoral plates, Greek muscle cuirasses, Celtic chainmail & the Iconic Lorica Segmentata. 

Also the hoplite shield (Aspis), Italo Corinthian helmet, and Rome's critical long Scutum shields.

videos.description:
How a Roman Firefighter, Crassus, became Rome's richest man in the time of Julius Caesar, the late Roman Republic. Why Rome had no fire department and why Rome was so prone to fire.
